senses.gloss: (= אַל־לי׳ = עַל־לי׳) according to the opinion, in the sense of.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 13a:20">B. Kam. 13ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>א׳ דמאן</he> in whose sense? in accordance with whom? <cite ref="Sotah 21a:13">Sot. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ דהלכתא</he> in accord. with the adopted decision.
<cite ref="Shabbat 28b:12">Sabb. 28ᵇ</cite>, a. v. fr. <he>א׳ דר׳</he> in the sense, developing the opinion, of R.—.
